note: EVAL-5's current security corpus. Every Knowledge source declares each reader readable or forbidden, and the loader rejects an undeclared pair. The vault owner and teammate are structurally placed in the same workspace and use the same project. The owner holds a workspace content role; the teammate's role starts at the child project and cannot flow upward. Both may read ordinary workspace Knowledge through placement, while only the owner has explicit authority for confidential workspace Knowledge. Governing scope and sensitivity are applied only through capture acceptance and VedaFlow. The three forge probes carry the current ContextRun envelope vocabulary; every selected address and rendered line must remain attributable without allowing source content to mint structure.
